model-agency.lead: OpenUP model agency in Moscow. The site already ran on Tilda but looked dated and responded sluggishly. We redesigned the home page, header and footer, cleaned up the model catalogues and made the site bilingual.

facts.v: Refresh the site and open it to an English-speaking audience
Redesign and hand-written markup on top of Tilda
Home page, header, footer, catalogues, ru/en translation

blocks.title: The starting point
paragraphs: The agency's site ran on Tilda but looked dated: the styling lagged behind how model agencies present themselves today, and some of the content had not been updated in a long time.
The interface was slow to respond, and the navigation followed old patterns and no longer fit every section — and the agency has many: women, men, arrivals, new faces, international, production.

blocks.title: What we built
paragraphs: We designed a new home page, header and footer, then built them ourselves — not assembled from ready-made blocks, but written as markup and styles by hand on top of the builder.

The header gained a multi-level menu with dropdown sections, the mobile version a burger panel with social links, and on small screens the footer collapses its sections into an accordion. None of this comes with Tilda out of the box.

blocks.title: Model catalogues
paragraphs: The catalogues run on Tilda Store, and the default card layout did not suit the agency: a model roster is a showcase, not a product list.
We changed the display format, the card corner radii and their placement on the page, then went through the breakpoints separately so the grid holds on any screen.

blocks.title: Bilingual without a second site
paragraphs: Tilda offers no real bilingual support: the usual route is duplicating every page and then maintaining two copies of the site. Instead we wrote a script that translates the page on the fly when the ru or en button is clicked.

It carries its own dictionary of more than 800 pairs; strings missing from it are fetched from external translators with a fallback and then cached. Catalogue search is solved separately: model names are stored in Latin script, so a Russian query is rewritten inside the request to the server — visitors search in Russian and find what they need.

blocks.title: The outcome
paragraphs: Everything visible was refreshed: the home page, header, footer and catalogues. The navigation now fits every section of the agency, including the link to its children's branch.

The English version runs without a second site and without duplicate pages — there is one set of pages and one dictionary to maintain, and that dictionary is edited in a Google Sheet without touching code. The client does not share business metrics, so the numbers here are about our work only: everything described can be checked by opening the site.

skynia-hall.lead: SKYNIA HALL is an event venue next to Volgogradsky Prospekt metro: a main hall for 1,200 guests, a small hall and six meeting rooms. The old site showed the hall as one long page and didn't answer the key question — will it work for my wedding, conference or prom? We rebuilt the site from design to forms and kept the venue on Tilda, where it's comfortable.

facts.v: A site that sells the hall for a specific event and collects requests
Redesign and custom code blocks inside Tilda
Home page, 12 format pages, booking, legal pages

metrics.label: from choosing a hall to a request

blocks.title: The starting point
paragraphs: The venue had a draft of a new site and a clear feeling: it should look premium, not templated. The old Tilda page showed the hall, but guests had to call to find out whether their event would fit, what it cost and whether the date was free.
Booking lived on a separate page and requests had to be clarified by phone — a long way for someone who just wanted to ask about Saturday.

blocks.title: Design in three rounds
paragraphs: The first, light version felt too plain. The second — a serif and gold — was beautiful but hard to read. The third kept the dark background and gold accent but switched to Geologica and Golos Text: premium and easy to read on a phone.

We removed extra labels, left the first screen with a headline, one line and two buttons, and gave every section a clear next step. On desktop a short “Check available dates” form sits next to the hero.

blocks.title: Three-step booking
paragraphs: The separate booking page became a three-step window: hall and format, date and guests, contacts. A preliminary total is shown right away, the draft is saved if the guest gets distracted, and the selection can be sent to WhatsApp with one button.
On phones a smart bar sits at the bottom: its button label changes by section — “Book the hall”, “Pick a format”, “Ask a question” — and a round button opens call, WhatsApp and Telegram.

blocks.title: 12 pages for event formats
paragraphs: Wedding, corporate party, conference, prom, concert, training, exhibition and five more formats got their own pages: a headline for the search query, fitting photos, real events from the venue, answers to common questions and a form that already knows which event it's about.
Each page has its own meta tags, Schema.org markup and social cover, and they all share one frame: a new landing page is assembled from ready blocks rather than built from scratch.

blocks.title: Our own code inside Tilda
paragraphs: The venue wanted to stay on Tilda and edit texts and photos itself. So the design is built from custom blocks with our code: the editor works as usual and the layout holds on every screen.
The header, footer and booking window are shared across the site. Requests from every form land in Tilda CRM marked with the page and form they came from.

blocks.title: Speed, search and legal pages
paragraphs: Photos are served as WebP through Tilda's CDN, fonts are uploaded to the platform and unused code is stripped at build time: the mobile version scores 97 of 100 for performance in Lighthouse and 100 for accessibility, SEO and best practices.
We added a personal data policy, a separate consent document and a short cookie notice; Yandex Metrica starts only after it.

blocks.title: The outcome
paragraphs: The site now leads a guest from the event format to a request instead of just showing the hall. The venue updates texts, photos and prices itself, and new pages are built from the same block system.
The new version is being prepared to move to the main domain — we'll add a link to the live site after launch.

privacy.title: Personal Data Processing Policy
privacy.intro: This page describes what personal data the sandwor.ru website collects, why and on what legal basis, to whom and where it is transferred, how long it is kept, how it is protected and how you can manage it. Separate from this policy there are three consents to data processing: when sending a request, to cookies and web analytics, and when requesting materials. Each is a document of its own.

sections.heading: 1. The operator and general provisions
paragraphs: The personal data operator is {operator}, a self-employed professional income tax payer{inn_part}{address_part} (the Operator). The Operator provides services under the sandwor name and owns the sandwor.ru website (the Site).

This policy follows Federal Law No. 152-FZ of 27.07.2006 "On Personal Data" and is published on the Site with free access (art. 18.1 part 2). It covers all data the Operator receives through the Site, its online chat, email, phone and the messengers listed on the Site.

The Operator does not process special categories of personal data (health, beliefs and the like) or biometric data. No decisions with legal consequences for you are made solely on the basis of automated processing.
Questions about data processing, requests and consent withdrawal: {email}.

sections.heading: 2. Whose data is processed
paragraphs: clients and people who contact the Operator about work — via the brief, chat, email, phone or a messenger;
company representatives who contact the Operator or sign a contract on behalf of a company;
Site visitors — web analytics data and server logs;
people who request materials on the Site, such as checklists.

sections.heading: 3. Requests, correspondence and contracts
paragraphs: Purpose: preparing, concluding and performing a civil law contract — reviewing a request or an inquiry, contacting you, preparing an offer, concluding and performing a service contract.

Data from the brief: name; phone number or Telegram username; preferred contact method; company name and number of salespeople, selected services, task description and budget — if you provide them. Stored together with the request: the page address, the visit source (campaign tags, the first page on the Site and the domain of the referring site), the date and time of sending and the consent record with its version number.

From the chat, email, phone and messengers: name or nickname, the contacts you provide, message text and attachments. When a contract is concluded — the data needed for the contract, payment and receipt.

Legal basis: for the brief — your consent, given with a separate checkbox (art. 6 part 1 clause 1 of 152-FZ); for inquiries via chat, email, phone or messenger — steps to conclude a contract at your request (art. 6 part 1 clause 5), and if you contact the Operator on behalf of a company — the Operator's legitimate interest in answering the inquiry (art. 6 part 1 clause 7); after a contract is concluded — its performance (art. 6 part 1 clause 5) and the Operator's obligations under tax law (art. 6 part 1 clause 2).

How it is processed: the request is sent over a secure connection (HTTPS) to the Site server, checked for spam and recorded in the amoCRM CRM system; it is not stored on the Site server. Chat conversations are stored in amoCRM, emails in the Mail.ru email service. Requests from the Site are not forwarded to messengers or email.

Retention: if no contract is concluded — until the purpose is achieved, but no longer than 1 year from the date of the request or the last message; if one is — for the term of the contract and 5 years after its performance (the retention period for income documents, Tax Code art. 23 para 1 subpara 8). The data is then destroyed (section 11).

sections.heading: 4. Materials in exchange for contact details
paragraphs: Purpose: providing materials (checklists) requested by Site visitors and answering questions about them if needed. The Operator does not send advertising based on this data.
Data: name; email address; which material you requested and on which page; the visit source; the date and time of the request and the consent record with its version number.
Legal basis: your consent, given with a separate checkbox in the form (art. 6 part 1 clause 1 of 152-FZ). The request is recorded in amoCRM.
Retention: until the purpose is achieved, but no longer than 1 year from the date of the request.

sections.heading: 5. Cookies and web analytics
paragraphs: Purpose: analysing Site traffic and how visitors use it, to evaluate traffic sources and improve the Site. The Yandex Metrica service is used for this.

Data: cookies and browser identifiers, IP address, information about the device, browser and operating system, addresses of the pages viewed and the referral source (including campaign tags), actions on pages — scrolling, clicks, navigation — and session recordings (Webvisor). The contents of input fields are not recorded: field recording in Webvisor is disabled and the forms on the Site are hidden from recording.

Legal basis: your consent to cookies and web analytics. On your first visit the Site shows the notice "By continuing to use the site, you agree to the use of cookies and Yandex Metrica". Until you continue to use the Site, Metrica is not loaded and no data is sent to it.

Continued use means: 5 seconds on a page, scrolling, a click or tap on the page, a key press (other than Tab and modifier keys), the "OK" button, closing the notice with Esc, or going to another page. Following the "Learn more" link to these terms and reading them does not count as continued use.

The consent record (its date) is kept in the browser for 12 months; while it exists, the notice is not shown and Metrica loads right away. If you leave without doing anything, no record is made and the notice will appear again next time.

How to refuse or withdraw consent: clear the Site data or block cookies in your browser settings, install the Yandex Metrica blocker (yandex.ru/support/metrica/ru/general/opt-out), or write to {email}. Refusing does not limit access to the Site.

Retention: the consent is valid for 1 year. Yandex keeps Webvisor recordings for 15 days and other data in Metrica according to the service rules. The Operator looks at aggregated reports and does not export data about individual visitors from Metrica.

YANDEX LLC processes Metrica data on the Operator's instructions (clause 5.4 of the Yandex Metrica Terms of Use) and also for the purposes set out in Yandex's own privacy policy. Metrica sets cookies on the Site domain and on Yandex domains.

sections.heading: 6. Server logs and data in your browser
paragraphs: Server logs. Each time the Site is accessed, the server records the IP address, the date and time of the request, the page address and browser information. Purpose: keeping the Site working and secure — finding failures and protecting against attacks. Legal basis: the Operator's legitimate interest (art. 6 part 1 clause 7 of 152-FZ) and the duty to keep data secure (art. 19). Logs are kept for no more than 3 months, are not combined with requests and are not used to identify you. To protect forms from spam, the server also keeps the sender's IP address in memory for 10 minutes.
Data in your browser — needed for the Site to work:
the cookie consent record — localStorage, 12 months;
the visit source: campaign tags, the first page and the referring domain — sessionStorage, until the tab is closed; the Operator receives it only if you send the brief or request a material;
which of the materials to show you — localStorage; after you consent to analytics, the variant is sent to Metrica together with goals;
data stored by the amoCRM chat button. The button loads from amoCRM servers after the cookie notice is hidden, and while loading the browser sends them its IP address and browser information.

sections.heading: 7. Who receives the data
paragraphs: The Operator does not sell personal data or share it for advertising. The following process data on the Operator's instructions, only to the extent needed for their service:
JSC amoCRM (TIN 7709477879; 38 Lyusinovskaya St., Moscow 115093) — the amoCRM CRM system and the online chat on the Site: storing requests, material requests and correspondence;
JSC Selectel (TIN 7810962785; 21A Tsvetochnaya St., St. Petersburg 196006) — hosting: the Site server that requests pass through, and server logs;
YANDEX LLC (TIN 7736207543; 16 Lva Tolstogo St., Moscow 119021) — Yandex Metrica (section 5).

Services you use on their own terms: Mail.ru email — VK LLC (OGRN 1027739850962; 39 bld. 79 Leningradsky Ave., Moscow 125167) stores the emails you send to the Operator; Telegram and WhatsApp — if you message the Operator there yourself (section 8). WhatsApp is owned by Meta Platforms, Inc., whose activities are recognised as extremist and banned in Russia.
Data is disclosed to government authorities only when required by law.

sections.heading: 8. Where the data is stored
paragraphs: Recording, systematisation, accumulation, storage, updating and retrieval of personal data of Russian citizens take place in databases located in Russia: on the Site server, in amoCRM, in Yandex Metrica and in Mail.ru email (art. 18 part 5 of 152-FZ).

The Operator does not transfer personal data abroad. If you message the Operator on Telegram or WhatsApp yourself, the conversation is stored on those services' servers outside Russia under their rules. To keep your data in Russia, use the brief, the chat on the Site, email or phone.

sections.heading: 9. How the data is protected
paragraphs: The Operator's information system has been assigned security level 4 (Government Decree No. 1119 of 01.11.2012), and the possible harm to data subjects has been assessed (Roskomnadzor Order No. 178 of 27.10.2022).

Measures: data is transmitted only over a secure connection (HTTPS); only the Operator has access to requests and correspondence; the CRM, hosting, analytics and email accounts are protected with passwords and two-factor authentication, and server access is key-based; software is kept up to date; forms are checked for spam and no unnecessary data is collected; Webvisor does not record input fields.
In the event of a data breach the Operator notifies Roskomnadzor: of the breach itself within 24 hours and of the investigation results within 72 hours (art. 21 part 3.1 of 152-FZ).

sections.heading: 10. Your rights and how to exercise them
paragraphs: You have the right to:
find out whether the Operator processes your data and receive information about the processing and the data itself;
demand that your data be corrected, blocked or destroyed if it is incomplete, outdated, inaccurate, unlawfully obtained or not needed for the stated purpose;
withdraw your consent and demand that processing stop;
appeal against the Operator's actions to Roskomnadzor or in court.

How to make a request: write to {email} from the address or number you used in your request or correspondence, so the Operator can see the request comes from you. You can also send a written request: by law it states the number of your identity document, its date of issue and issuing authority, details of your contact with the Operator (for example, the date of your request) and your signature, which may be electronic (art. 14 part 3 of 152-FZ).

Timeframes: information about processing — within 10 working days, extendable by 5 working days with a stated reason; correction or destruction based on the information you provide — within 7 working days; stopping processing at your demand — within 10 working days, extendable by 5.

sections.heading: 11. Consent withdrawal, end of processing and destruction
paragraphs: Consent is withdrawn by writing to {email}. The Operator stops processing and destroys the data within 30 days unless there are other legal grounds to keep it (for example, a contract still being performed). For withdrawing consent to web analytics, see section 5.

When the purpose is achieved or the retention period expires, data is destroyed within 30 days; data processed unlawfully — within 10 working days. If data cannot be destroyed within these periods, it is blocked and destroyed within 6 months.

Destruction is confirmed by a record and an extract from the event log of the system where the data was stored (Roskomnadzor Order No. 179 of 28.10.2022). The record and the extract are kept for 3 years.

sections.heading: 12. Changes to the policy
paragraphs: The Operator updates this policy when purposes, data or services change. A new version takes effect when published on this page; its date is shown at the top. If purposes or data that require consent change, the Operator will ask for consent again.

consent.title: Consents to Personal Data Processing
consent.intro: The sandwor.ru website has three consents — one for each processing purpose. Each is a separate document and is requested only where it is needed. How data is processed is described in the policy.

sections.heading: Consent when sending a request
sections.title: Consent to personal data processing when sending a request
sections.summary: Given by ticking a separate checkbox before sending the brief. Without it the brief cannot be sent — email or call instead.
paragraphs: By ticking "I consent to the processing of personal data to review my request" and sending the brief on sandwor.ru, I freely, of my own will and in my own interest consent to {operator_dat}, a self-employed professional income tax payer{inn_part}{address_part} (the Operator), processing my personal data on the terms below.

Actions: collection, recording, systematisation, accumulation, storage, updating, retrieval, use, transfer (provision, access) to processors, blocking, deletion and destruction — with and without automation.

Data is processed in databases located in Russia.
Term: the consent is valid until the purpose is achieved, but no longer than 1 year from the date of the request. If we conclude a contract, the data is processed to perform it under the policy.
Withdrawal: at any time by writing to {email}. The Operator will stop processing and destroy the data within 30 days unless there are other legal grounds to keep it.
Together with the request the Operator keeps a consent record: the date and time, the version number and the address of this text.

sections.heading: Consent to cookies and web analytics
sections.title: Consent to the use of cookies and Yandex Metrica
sections.summary: Given by continuing to use the site after the cookie notice. Until then Yandex Metrica is not loaded.
paragraphs: By continuing to use sandwor.ru after the cookie notice, I consent to {operator_dat} (the Operator) processing the data collected by the Yandex Metrica service.

Continued use means: 5 seconds on a page, scrolling, a click or tap on the page, a key press (other than Tab and modifier keys), the "OK" button, closing the notice with Esc, or going to another page. Following the "Learn more" link to this text and reading it does not count as consent. Until consent is given, Metrica is not loaded.
Purpose: analysing site traffic and how visitors use the site, evaluating traffic sources and improving the site.

Data: cookies and browser identifiers, IP address, information about the device, browser and operating system, addresses of the pages viewed, the referral source and campaign tags, actions on pages and session recordings (Webvisor) without the contents of input fields.
Actions: collection, recording, storage, use in aggregated form, transfer to the processor, deletion — with automation.
Processor: YANDEX LLC (TIN 7736207543; 16 Lva Tolstogo St., Moscow 119021) — on the Operator's instructions under the Yandex Metrica Terms of Use. Data is stored in databases located in Russia.

Term: 1 year; the consent record is kept in the browser for 12 months. You can refuse without losing access to the site: clear the site data or block cookies in your browser, install the Yandex Metrica blocker (yandex.ru/support/metrica/ru/general/opt-out), or write to {email}.
